newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Dalai Lama meets Australia's Howard amid China row.
newsitem.headline: Dalai Lama meets Australia's Howard amid China row.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard met Tibet's spiritual leader the Dalai Lama on Thursday despite Chinese threats of trade retaliation over the meeting.
Australia's conservative prime minister received the Tibetan Buddhist god-king in his Sydney office for what Howard's aides said was a private meeting.
About 50 pro-Tibet demonstrators were waiting outside Howard's Sydney office when the Dalai Lama arrived.
The Dalai Lama told reporters the main point of the meeting was "to materialise meaningful negotiations on Tibet's future."
Asked if the meeting would annoy China, the Dalai Lama said: "I hope not, but anyway in Chinese eyes this seems something negative but in fact it is not."

China on Tuesday threatened unspecified trade sanctions against Australia after Howard's office said he would meet the Dalai Lama despite warnings from Beijing that he should not. China regards the Dalai Lama as a separatist trouble-maker.
